notes: The single scheduled run occurs after the prior US close and uses completed daily bars only.
Massive is used only for the declared stock universe; Cboe public daily CSVs are used for VIX and VIX3M.
VIX3M is never substituted. If the free Cboe file is unavailable or stale, this run produces no target.

The free EOD provider-delimited window is bounded at 730 calendar days (about two years); its actual common first date is treated as the complete dataset boundary. The first 150 NYSE sessions are context-only warm-up for v12.2, and the first indicator-ready signal date is computed dynamically and recorded in Evidence.
The current v12.2 replay still uses QQQ/BIL/VXX for the frozen target profile; other ETFs are captured for data coverage and future read-only observation only.
M21 is paper-only and does not create broker orders.
